description: Frozen golden manifest for the cumulative Phase-7 catalog (guanlan_v2.orchestration.phase7_registry.phase7_catalog_snapshot). base_catalog_digest MUST equal the immutable cumulative Phase-6 catalog digest (guanlan_v2.orchestration.shadow.PHASE6_CATALOG_DIGEST), the sole legal base; result_catalog_digest seals the cumulative Phase-7 catalog. Phase 7 adds ZERO workers and ZERO capabilities and ONLY the three catalog-owned planner materials (system prompt + guardrail content, SKILL.md skill) under source_identity orchestrator.planner. The Planner is deliberately NOT a selectable WorkerSpec (a final spec would be dynamic_allowed and could recursively select itself; materials-without-worker is the reviewed containment), so count_final_workers is unchanged from Phase 6 and every inherited Phase-6 worker/capability passes through byte-identical. planner_spec_digest is the frozen semantic digest of build_phase7_planner_spec over this catalog. NEVER auto-regenerated by tests. See tests/orchestration/test_phase7_registry.py.
